builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21: Hudl's public rosters for every school's girls soccer teams and a SportsRecruits profile-address probe and NCSA, over the JV players MaxPreps lists; each page read at least twice by the pass that found it.
notes: The JV players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of data/soccer/rosters-enrichment.json's profiles[]. Joined on team slug + the name the team page's JV list gives. No claimed-MaxPreps pages (the JV career pages were not read). A player on both the JV list and the varsity roster has her pages in the varsity file. The stale-grade marker is varsity-only: a JV page whose class year disagrees with the JV list is not linked. Recall is partial.
Counts as written: 32 profiles for 31 JV players at 11 schools (5 NCSA, 3 SportsRecruits, 24 Hudl).
